name: Shirasagi Toshihiko
source:
Toshihiko Shirasagi is [url=/c19088]Sayuri[/url]'s husband. He does not hold a lot of authority in the Shirasagi household though he actually often takes on the tasks assigned by [url=/c19096]Tomoe[/url] due to his wife's weak body.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimi_no_Nagori_wa_Shizuka_ni_Yurete]Wikipedia[/url].]
